correctness.rationale: The full proof establishes the automorphism group form, its pointwise two-mark stabilizer orbits, exact class sizes, explicit first-round singleton witnesses covering every value of H in each of three named projections, and second-round recovery of κ. Sharpness is supplied by explicit first-round collisions and direct boundary analysis for d=1 and (d,r)=(2,1). All quantifiers d>=1, distinct marks, r in {1,2}, named reflexive relations, and self-inclusion in counts are stated. The 27-configuration refinement verifier and 15-configuration independent GL enumeration match; finite checks are corroboration rather than the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural exact individualization/refinement invariant for the Latin-three-net representation of elementary abelian binary groups. It supplies a dimension-independent sharp two-round stabilizer-orbit recovery theorem and exact 4/10/11 or 16/28/29 class and multiplicity formulas on structures of size 2^(2d). The witness mechanism shows how two named table cells reconstruct all points of a small generated subspace through counting, and how that suffices to separate every orbit. It is neither a mere naming/substitution of general autotopism theory nor an arbitrary finite parameter slice; the family is unbounded and logically motivated. No claim of global identification or downstream canonization is made.
